corpus.text: Full-time employees receive twenty days of paid annual leave each calendar year.
Employees may take ten paid sick days for illness or medical appointments.
Primary caregivers qualify for sixteen weeks of paid parental leave.
Passwords must contain at least fourteen characters and must not be reused across systems.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for remote access and administrator accounts.
Suspected security incidents must be reported to the SOC within thirty minutes.
Expense reports must be submitted in Concur within thirty days of purchase.
International travel requires manager approval before tickets are booked.
Supplier invoices use payment terms of net forty-five days unless a contract overrides them.
Production databases are backed up nightly and retained for thirty-five days.
The recovery time objective for tier-one services is four hours.
Company laptops must install operating system security updates within seven days.
New employees complete a probation period lasting ninety calendar days.
Performance reviews take place twice per year in June and December.
The employee referral bonus is paid after the referred hire completes six months.
Customer support recordings are deleted after one hundred eighty days.
Data access requests must be acknowledged within three business days.
Personal data exports are encrypted before delivery to the requester.
The Bengaluru office is open from eight in the morning until eight in the evening.
Visitors must show identification and wear a temporary badge at all times.
Every production code change requires approval from one engineer other than the author.
Emergency releases require an incident ticket and retrospective review.
Priority one customer cases have a fifteen-minute initial response target.
Unresolved priority two cases are escalated after four hours.
